text:
maria: quick sync — last night's slab-sampler tweak (velocity clamp + token-headroom) seems to have changed KV warmup behavior on prod pools. saw more 95th latency spikes around midnight. anyone else?
ryan: saw that too, noticed increased cold-hit ratio on the 2x-4x microbatches span. trace sample attached. :thinking:
jin: thx — looking at profiler now. early signal: kernel selection bounced between fused-attn-v2 and fallback for mid-length prompts (80-160). suspecting jitter from decode-rate classifier.
sam: can you paste the classifier thresholds? iirc we switched to decode-ms-per-token based buckets last week.
jin: current config (from canary):
```
{"buckets": ["fast","mid","slow"], "decode_ms_thresholds": [1.8, 4.0], "token_budget_target": 48}
```
maria: that token_budget_target was lowered to reduce tail latency for fast paths, but maybe it starves KV prefetch for mid prompts. perf-bot, do we have the KV warmup % delta?
perf-bot: KV_PREFETCH_WARMUP_DELTA: +12% (23:00-01:00 UTC), sample window 200k requests, p95 latency +18ms on affected pools.
ryan: that matches the trace — more requests entered without full KV priming, leading to small decode stalls. proposal: make token_budget adaptive by bucket and keep a min_prefetch_tokens.
sam: propose config change: token_budget_target -> per-bucket: {"fast":32, "mid":64, "slow":96}, min_prefetch_tokens: 24. also add a hysteresis window for classifier flips (200ms).
jin: adding hysteresis should avoid kernel-selection thrash. also want to refine the classifier input: use first-8-token decode_ms moving average instead of 1-token instant. reduces noise for short prompts.
maria: agree. can we sim locally? run replay on nightly trace with new per-bucket budget and hysteresis. ryan, can you run batcher-sim with these params and drop results here?
ryan: running now. quick numbers from 10k replay: p95 latency down -6ms on mid bucket, KV cold-hit down 9%, overall throughput +2.4%. putting full output below: 
```
SUMMARY: baseline vs candidate
mid-bucket p95: 92ms -> 86ms
mid-bucket kv-cold-hit: 18% -> 9%
overall throughput: 1800rps -> 1843rps
instances where kernel flipped mid-decode: 320 -> 42
```
jin: nice. one more concern: kernel selection map needs a slight preference for fused-attn-v2 for mid-length when decode-rate ~3ms/token to exploit faster path. otherwise routing picks fallback. i'll add a tie-breaker weight +0.1 for fused path.
sam: SGTM. schedule canary 02:30 UTC for 1h on pool-b (low traffic). add observability: per-bucket token_budget, kernel-flip-rate, kv-prefetch-hits.
maria: i'll open a rollout ticket, include rollback plan and success metrics (p95 down or no regression, kv-cold-hit <12%). thanks team. :rocket:
